title: Missing spacing between content title and breadcrumbs in admin header
author: vitorvecchi91
body_preview: The content title (`content_title`) and the breadcrumbs block are rendered side by side inside a flex container without spacing utilities.  This results in insufficient visual separation between the two elements.  A Bootstrap `gap` utility could improve spacing in a cleaner and more maintainable way.
